what: Related changes belong in one transaction, one undo step.

source: instructions rule, docs/wp-notes/mcp-cli.md

what: A command with an unfamiliar shape: the schema is looked up, not guessed.
source: instructions rule

what: A one-line request must not run the whole brief → digest → propose workflow.
source: text review: the numbered workflow reads as mandatory

what: A named trim is a direct edit, not a proposal.
source: skills/jasper-editor/SKILL.md

what: A multi-step cut goes through one reviewable proposal, never straight onto the timeline.
source: spec 18 AF-PROP
prompt: Make a rough cut of the interview: keep the best take of each line and drop the false start. Then wait for my review.

what: Which take is better is answered from the digest and takes, not by asking the user.

what: Never ask what a tool can measure.

what: Media without a transcript: transcribe, wait for the job, read the digest.

what: An export is verified by measuring the file before it is called done.

what: A long transcription outlived transcribe's wait and its words were never committed; committing the job while it still ran was refused (E_NOT_READY: wait_for_job first).
text: transcribe E_TIMEOUT hint; `jobIds` waits for jobs still running
source: real cut, 2026-11-13: about 30 min of audio, transcribe {wait: true} through the CLI timed out and nothing was committed
prompt: Get that transcript into the project now.

priorTurns.text: The transcription took longer than the wait; it is still running on the engine and nothing is in the project yet.

calls.result: {"error": {"code": "E_TIMEOUT", "message": "The transcription is still running after 600 s: nothing is committed yet", "hint": "The jobs keep running. Call transcribe {\"projectId\":\"{{project}}\",\"jobIds\":[\"{{pendingJob}}\"]}: it waits for them (timeoutSeconds) and commits the transcript.", "details": {"jobIds": ["{{pendingJob}}"]}}}

what: add_transition with clipId + edge on a clip that another clip touched made a two-sided transition (the clip before slid too, spilling its handles); the agent removed it and moved the clip to an empty track.
text: add_transition: clipId + edge is one-sided (description, clipId, details) and its result note

prompt: On V2, slide the clip that starts at frame 401 in from below: a 30-frame smooth-slide, direction up, on its head, single-sided like in Premiere. The clip before it must not slide.

what: A transition between two clips goes on the edit point (track + at), now that clipId + edge is one-sided.
text: add_transition: track + at joins both clips (description, track); the one-sided result note
source: Assembly notes of a JasperEditor editing chat, 2026-11 ("JasperEditor bugs / quirks" 1): smooth-slide up on the head of a V2 clip at 401 next to a clip at 363-401; control for transition-one-sided-next-to-clip
prompt: Put a 10-frame cross-dissolve between the two clips on V2.

what: measure_loudness on a long sequence through a slow Pitch Shifter waited for the whole mix inside one engine request and timed out at 180 s twice; the user had to solo A1 and export a WAV to get the numbers.

prompt: How loud is A1 on its own over the whole sequence? I need the integrated loudness and the true peak.
